description: This file defines data structures related to rebalancing reports and statistics in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes an enum for rebalancer status, and immutable structs for reporting rebalancing state and statistics per silo.

classes.name: RebalancingReport
classes.description: An immutable report structure capturing the state of the activation rebalancer, including host, status, suspension duration, imbalance level, and statistics.

classes.name: RebalancingStatistics
classes.description: An immutable structure for diagnostics, capturing timestamped stats about activations dispersed and acquired by a silo.
